blocks.en: # Methods and references **English** · [简体中文](REFERENCES.zh-CN.md) [Repository home](../README.md#contents) ## Evidence for the workflow | Method | Papers and official instructions | | --- | --- | | CPU and CUDA batch docking | The Vina papers describe its scoring and search, while the Uni-Dock paper describes its GPU screening implementation. Validate the engines separately against the same co-crystal reference. [Vina 1.2 paper](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jcim.1c00203) · [Uni-Dock paper](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jctc.2c01145) · [Vina batch manual](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docking_in_batch.html) · [Docking validation review](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10822-026-00849-8) | | Chemical state and pose recovery | The Molscrub manual covers state generation, the Meeko paper and export docs explain mapped recovery, and the RDKit guide covers independent chemical-graph checks. [Molscrub CLI](https://molscrub.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cli.html) · [Meeko paper](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jcim.5c02271) · [Meeko export](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/export_usage.html) · [RDKit guide](https://www.rdkit.org/docs/GettingStartedInPython.html) | | AMBER99SB-ILDN + GAFF2 / AM1-BCC | Cite the protein force field, ligand force field, and charge model separately. Use the selected AmberTools manual for the GAFF2 implementation. [AMBER99SB-ILDN](https://doi.org/10.1002/prot.22711) · [GAFF paper](https://doi.org/10.1002/jcc.20035) · [AM1-BCC](https://doi.org/10.1002/jcc.10128) · [ACPYPE](https://doi.org/10.1186/1756-0500-5-367) · [Amber manuals](https://ambermd.org/Manuals.php) | | CHARMM36m + CGenFF | CHARMM36m and CGenFF cover the protein and organic ligand, respectively. Use upstream docs to select the matching port and stream version and assess penalties. [CHARMM36m](https://doi.org/10.1038/nmeth.4067) · [CGenFF](https://doi.org/10.1002/jcc.21367) · [MacKerell force-field releases](https://mackerell.umaryland.edu/charmm_ff.shtml) · [CGenFF usage](https://docs.silcsbio.com/2026/cgenff/usage.html) | | MD checks and optional endpoint energies | The GROMACS manual documents setup and restart commands. The reproducibility checklist guides sampling and replicate reporting. The gmx_MMPBSA paper describes the endpoint calculation. [GROMACS manual](https://manual.gromacs.org/2026.3/) · [Managing simulations](https://manual.gromacs.org/2026.3/user-guide/managing-simulations.html) · [MD reproducibility checklist](https://doi.org/10.1038/s42003-023-04653-0) · [gmx_MMPBSA paper](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jctc.1c00645) | ## Tools, official documentation, and upstream repositories Cite the versions and modules you used. J Chem Inf Model. 2019. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jcim.9b00269) ### Feedback Corrections and reproducible issue reports are welcome. Include the relevant section, software versions, platform, and a minimal example. If the guide helps your research or teaching, consider starring the repository. [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/LuciferBioLab/docking-gromacs-tutorial/issues) [Back to contents](../README.md#contents) ## Disclaimer This independent repository is a reference for academic research and training. Check the example parameters, cutoffs, structures, figures, and commands against your research question, system, and computing environment. Docking scores, trajectory stability, and endpoint energies are model outputs. Experimental affinity, mechanism, and clinical conclusions require independent evidence. Third-party software, force fields, databases, and examples are governed by their own licenses, service terms, and citation policies. Listing a tool credits its contribution and implies no endorsement by its developers or institution. **Verification scope.** The example commands and file transfers were checked against upstream documentation and public examples. Record target-hardware verification for CUDA batch docking and production MD under each force-field protocol. The third-party Agent and MCP integrations are documented options. ## Acknowledgments We thank the authors, maintainers, and contributors of AutoDock Vina, Uni-Dock, Molscrub, Meeko, RDKit, Open Babel, ACPYPE, and GROMACS. Their code, documentation, and examples make the workflow easier to inspect and reproduce. We also thank the AmberTools, CHARMM/CGenFF, Lemkul Lab, GLYCAM, and PACKMOL-Memgen teams for force fields, parameterization, conversion, and system-building resources. We thank the open-source PyMOL, MDAnalysis, gmx_MMPBSA, pandas, Matplotlib, seaborn, Inkscape, and GIMP communities for their analysis and figure tools, conda-forge for packaging, and RCSB PDB, PubChem, and BioExcel for public data and examples. We also thank the maintainers of nature-skills, Superpowers, and drmedia/photoshop-mcp for sharing optional editing and layout tools. Cite the software, data, and methods used in your study. [Tools and upstream repositories](#sources)
